newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Six acquitted of murder in S.African Malan trial.
newsitem.headline: Six acquitted of murder in S.African Malan trial.

text.p: A South African judge on Thursday acquitted six blacks of carrying out a 1987 political massacre for which former defence minister Magnus Malan is accused of being ultimately responsible.

"Accused number one to six have not been proved guilty of the offences charged, they have been acquitted," Judge Jan Hugo told a packed court in the Indian Ocean port of Durban. Hugo has yet to deliver his verdict against Malan himself and eight others also charged with the murder of 13 blacks in KwaMakutha settlement near Durban.
